tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i bstod gsol byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gī nī ye/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad skyed pa'i yum/ /'gro la rjes chags pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'bar ba'i spyan gsum g.yo/ /dpal ldan mkha' spyod dbang mor bdag phyag 'tshal/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde ba che/ /rang bzhin dmigs med snying rjes yongs su gang / /'phrin las rgyun mi chad cing 'gog pa med/ /sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan dbang mor bstod/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan 'phrin las sna tshogs gar/ /gar gyis 'gro kun don gnyis ldan par bsgyur/ /bsgyur mdzad grangs med mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mchog /mchog khyod bcol zol min par snying nas bstod/ /drug cu rtsa gnyis 'khor lo smin byas nas/ /lhan skyes ngo sprod byin rlabs sgo phye ste/ /mkha' spyod bskyed rdzogs lam la rtag bsgrub pas/ /mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang thob par mdzod/ /he ru ka dpal gsung gi bden pa dang / /nyid kyis mkhas grub bgrang yas rjes bzung tshul/ /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i bden pa yis/ /myur du 'dzum zhal dge mas rjes 'dzin shog /de ltar tshe 'dir mkha' spyod dbang mo'i zhal/ /mngon sum mjal ba'i skal ba med na yang / /'chi ba'i rnam rtog 'pho bas mtshams sbyar nas/ /bar do med par mkha' spyod 'grub par shog /gal te rnam shes bar dor 'khyams srid na/ /'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi nyam nga'i g.yang sa gsum/ /ma nges rtags drug la sogs shar ba'i tshe/ /de'i rkyen gyis drin can bla ma dang / /dga' ba gsum gyi rnal 'byor dran pa'i mthus/ /de ma thag tu mkha' spyod dbang mo dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi mdun bsus te/ /phyin chad las nyon skye sgo chod par shog /bla ma yi dam mchog gsum thugs rje dang / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha'i mthu stobs dang /

/chos nyid 'gyur med rten 'brel bslu med mthus/ /smon pa'i gnas 'di bgegs med grub gyur cig /ces rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bstod pa smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni/ dge slong chos dkar gyis yi ge'i lam nas yang yang bskul ba'i gsung ngor bya bral ba/ sangs rgyas ming can gyis e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i bstod gsol byin rlabs myur 'jug PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
